<issue>
Tokenizer incorrectly advances position when scanning keywords

#### Description

The tokenizer is advancing by an incorrect amount when processing keywords, causing it to skip characters and produce malformed token sequences.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from sqlglot import Tokenizer
from sqlglot.dialects import BigQuery

# Test with jinja-style templates
tokenizer = BigQuery.Tokenizer()
tokens = tokenizer.tokenize("{{ x }}")
print([(token.token_type, token.text) for token in tokens])
# Expected: proper token sequence with correct braces
# Actual: malformed tokens due to position advancement issue

# Test with space-separated keywords  
tokens = Tokenizer().tokenize("group by")
print([(token.token_type, token.text) for token in tokens])
# Expected: 2 tokens
# Actual: incorrect number of tokens due to position skipping
```

The tokenizer appears to be skipping characters when processing certain keyword patterns, leading to incorrect tokenization of SQL statements containing jinja templates and space-separated keywords.
</issue>
